nodes.question: How has Costa Rica contributed to the recognition of the right to a healthy environment?
nodes.answer: Costa Rica added the right to a healthy environment to its constitution in 1994, leading to significant environmental protections and practices, including high levels of national park land and reliance on renewable energy.
